title: Multicultural Spyfall: Assessing LLMs through Dynamic Multilingual Social Deduction Game

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance in the social deduction game Spyfall by replacing generic locations with culturally specific entities like local locations and traditional foods from China, Egypt, and Indonesia.

Comparing model strategic reasoning, win rates, and instruction-following capabilities across multiple languages (English, Simplified Chinese, Indonesian, and Egyptian Arabic) in a game setting to identify performance gaps in non-English contexts.
